# Tokyo Family Stays

> > Tokyo Family Stays offers furnished vacation rentals and monthly apartments across Shinjuku, Shibuya, Nakano, and other Tokyo neighborhoods for families, digital nomads, and travelers.

Founded by Tracey Northcott and Ashley Thredgold, Tokyo Family Stays specializes in family-friendly short-term and monthly accommodations throughout Tokyo. Properties range from studios to 4-bedroom houses, with convenient access to JR Yamanote Line, Shinjuku Station, and major airports via Narita Express and Airport Limousine Bus.
